findings.title: The route of the purge flow and the reaction of the axial load are not described
findings.attack: No paragraph states the inlet or the outlet of the purge gap, although [0127] says the exit is described. The fit band closes the annular clearance at one end. A ring that expands moves towards the bore that surrounds it, and the text does not say which surfaces part. [0113] loads the upper edge while the figure instruction loads the fit-band end, and no reacting surface is named. The only tested form is open to an insufficiency attack that cannot be repaired after filing.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add from the inventors' prototype drawings the inlet and outlet of the purge gap, the surfaces that part, the surface loaded and the surface that reacts, and one enlarged figure of the purge gap at rest and open. No claim is narrowed.

findings.title: The dates of Example 1 cannot hold the protocol and the cycle counts stated
findings.attack: Each inflation cycle includes a hold of 24 hours, the prototypes completed 40 cycles and the comparative valve cores failed at cycles 12, 14 and 18, yet the test is recorded as carried out from 12 August to 20 August of 2026, nine days. The only measured evidence in the package is internally inconsistent and will be attacked as unreliable.
findings.least_narrowing_action: The inventors state from the test record the true dates, hold period and cycle counts, and the description is corrected to the record. Nothing is inferred by the drafter.

findings.title: The Background cites a publication that the prior-art index marks as fictional
findings.attack: [0007] attributes a disclosure to US2019/0123456A1. The prior-art index lists that number as a fictional test reference that is not a real publication. A Background statement is read as the applicant's account of the art; citing a document that does not exist misstates the art and raises a question of candour in the United States.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Remove [0007], or replace the citation with the true identity of the document once the human has confirmed it. No claim is affected.

findings.title: The description does not explain how the seat ring moves across the sealing face
findings.attack: By [0137] the seat ring recovers when the purge shoulder lifts, while the sealing face is still a full normal stroke, 0.6 mm in the prototype, from the sealing edge. [0138] offers a belief and no mechanism. Claims 32, 56 and 76 recite a movement that the description's own sequence does not explain, and any broader claim to the wipe has the same gap.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the inventors' account of which part of the seat ring meets which part of the poppet during recovery and at what point of the return travel, with any supporting observation. No claim is narrowed.

findings.title: The conversion of axial load into radial expansion is described in two ways that do not agree
findings.attack: [0134] and [0170] say the convolution flattens under the axial load; [0172] says the equivalent bow increases. The purge gap width of 0.15 mm exceeds the convolution amplitude of 0.12 mm from which it is said to arise. Claim 24 read with claim 22 claims a bow that flattens, against [0172].
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a paragraph and a figure stating the at-rest and loaded profile of the prototype wall. Make claim 24 depend on claim 21 only if the inventors confirm that the bow increases.

findings.title: Pressures and dimensions reached only under load cannot be proved without a stated test method
findings.attack: The crack pressure, the over-travel differential, the purge gap width and the austenite finish temperature are defined without a method of measurement, and no spring rate, axial load or effective area is given. The end points of every claimed range are open to dispute.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the method by which each prototype value was determined, and the spring rates and axial load of the prototype if the inventors have them.

findings.title: One valve pattern, one size and one actuation support claims that are general in all three
findings.attack: [0072] calls actuation by the pressure differential preferred and describes no other. The figure instructions and registry contain FIG. 13A, a Schrader-pattern core body 220, which the description never mentions. Every dimension belongs to one size of valve. A defendant in another pattern answers that the description supports one pattern only.
findings.least_narrowing_action: If the inventors confirm, add a paragraph on other actuation of the poppet, a description of FIG. 13A and the principal dimensions as ratios. If not, remove FIG. 13A from the drawings.

findings.title: The axially deflecting and tilting forms rest on one paragraph and no figure
findings.attack: A claim to a deflectable element would rest on [0179] and [0180] alone. The text does not identify the face, the route of the purge flow at the face or the meaning of tilting, and no figure shows the form.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add one figure of the disc spring form at rest and in the over-travel and a paragraph identifying the face, the route of the purge flow and one example of a tilting element.

findings.title: The thermal variant is disclosed, unclaimed and excluded by the definitions
findings.attack: The thermal variant has no over-travel and no load-applying surface, so by [0065] and [0099] it has neither a purge gap nor a radially deflectable element as defined. No claim covers it, no training method or data are given, and its publication here is prior art against a later filing.
findings.least_narrowing_action: The human decides: remove the variant and keep it for a later filing; or keep it with an independent claim, its own defined terms and an enabling description; or keep it as description only and accept the consequences.

findings.title: No example isolates the air purge, and no cold or fatigue test exists
findings.attack: Every independent claim turns on the purge gap, and the only observation about it is that the surface it sweeps carried cured sealant film. No test isolates either cleaning action, the ranges are untested and no cold or fatigue test exists. An opponent says the package makes the effect of the purge gap less credible.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Before filing, test one valve core in which the purge gap cannot open and one in which the seat ring recovers slowly, under the protocol of Example 1, and add the results whatever they show. No result may be supplied by the drafter.

findings.title: The normal stroke has one value and no range
findings.attack: Claim 34 is a single point, avoided by a normal stroke of 0.5 mm or 0.7 mm, and no intermediate fallback exists.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Ask the inventors for the range of the normal stroke and add it with the same caveat as [0230].

findings.title: "Air" is not defined to cover another inflation gas
findings.attack: [0212] and [0275] contemplate a CO2 cartridge, and nothing defines air or air purge to cover carbon dioxide or nitrogen. A defendant argues that inflation with a cartridge is outside the words of claim 2.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a definition that air means the gas delivered by the pump head, including carbon dioxide and nitrogen.

findings.title: Only prototype routes of manufacture are described
findings.attack: The polymer seat ring is turned from rod and the metal seat ring is laser cut and shape-set. A maker in volume would mould the polymer ring and may form the metal ring otherwise, so the manufacturing claims cover the routes a competitor is least likely to use.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Ask the inventors which routes they contemplate for volume and add them as alternatives.

assumptions.text: The package is the exact text to be filed; no abstract, drawings or priority document were supplied.
Statements about what a figure shows rest on the figure instructions.
Common general knowledge: a thin-walled tube with a wave in its wall shortens under axial compression by bending at the wave; the pressure drop across an open poppet depends on the flow.
The statement that S1 is a fictional test reference is taken from prior-art/INDEX.md as written; the requester-supplied file was not opened.
Legal premises on candour, dedication of unclaimed subject matter and credibility of a technical effect are stated from general knowledge for counsel to verify.

open_questions.text: Where does air enter and leave the purge gap of the prototype, which surfaces part, and which surface reacts the axial load?
What do the test records show for the dates, the hold period and the number of cycles of Example 1?
What is the true identity of the document cited at [0007], if any?
What touches what during the snap-back wipe, and when?
Does the convolution of the prototype flatten or deepen under the axial load?
Is a Schrader-pattern valve core, or actuation of the poppet other than by the pressure differential, within the inventors' conception?
Is the thermal variant to be claimed, kept for a later filing or left as description only?
Is there time before filing to run the two comparative tests of F-36-10?
